description: This Java source file defines the AmIpFilter class, which implements a servlet filter for handling proxy requests in a Spark on YARN deployment. It manages proxy host configurations, performs URL redirection, and handles user authentication cookies, primarily for Hadoop YARN resource management integration.

classes.name: AmIpFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter for proxy request handling in Spark on YARN, managing proxy URLs, user cookies, and redirection logic.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the filter with configuration parameters, setting up proxy hosts and URLs.

methods.name: getProxyAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves and caches the set of proxy host IP addresses, updating periodically.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Main filtering logic: redirects non-proxy requests, manages user cookies, and wraps requests with user principals.

methods.name: findRedirectUrl
methods.description: Determines the URL to redirect to based on configured proxy URLs.

methods.name: isValidUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is reachable and valid, considering security settings.

methods.name: setUpdateInterval
methods.description: Sets the interval for updating proxy IP addresses (test utility).
